patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Hive only if your buying job matches “Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — ” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than Hive's shape. Workflow advantage: Hive leans team-collaboration-work; Smartsheet leans resource-planning, timeline-reporting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Hive is Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — strong monday.com peer.; Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Hive (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Smartsheet (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Hive-leaning team-collaboration-work vs Smartsheet-leaning resource-planning, timeline-reporting.
- Researched limits: Hive — Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Smartsheet — No free plan.

Limitations — Hive: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Free storage (200MB) and AI credits (1k) are tight for active teams; Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump.

Poor-fit cases: Hive is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams · Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Avoid Hive if you actually need Smartsheet's motion (Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
